analysis.summary: In Q1 FY27, Krishana Phoschem Limited recorded revenue from operations of ₹532 crore, marking a 35% year-on-year growth, with profit after tax rising 54% year-on-year to ₹47 crore. The operating environment in early Q1 faced challenges from elevated raw material prices, geopolitical tensions in West Asia, and a delayed southwest monsoon. Operational performance recovered towards July as monsoon rainfall revived and raw material availability stabilized, leading management to project a quarterly turnover of over ₹500 crore for the remaining quarters of FY27. Krishana Phoschem reported a 34.58% YoY growth in revenue from operations to ₹532.3 crore and a 53.88% YoY increase in Profit After Tax to ₹47.06 crore for Q1 FY27. The company's recently expanded capacities at Meghnagar, including NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA, are contributing progressively to operational performance.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover growth over the previous year as production smoothens.
guidance.quote: We are hoping that over the remaining quarters, we will be able to smoothen our production, and we will be able to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over last year.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

guidance.claim: The company expects a top-line increase of around Rs. 500 crore from its recent capacity expansion.
guidance.quote: So, you can expect a top line increase of around Rs. 500 crore.

guidance.claim: The company expects 35% to 40% overall revenue growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: So overall, we hope 35%-40% revenue growth in FY27.

guidance.claim: For FY27, the company expects to import around 150,000 metric tons of material, generating approximately Rs. 1,000 crore in revenue.
guidance.quote: For FY27, based on market demand, we expect to import around 150,000 metric tons of material, which would translate into approximately Rs.1,000 crore of revenue.

demand_outlook.claim: Monsoon activity revived in early July, driving a recovery in sowing progress and accelerating fertilizer demand.
demand_outlook.quote: However, rainfall improved materially during early July, resulting in a rapid recovery in sowing progress, improved farmer sentiment, and accelerated fertilizer offtake across several key markets for the remainder of the Kharif season.

demand_outlook.claim: The quarter ended March 2026 experienced stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.
demand_outlook.quote: On the Rabi season, the quarter ended March ‘26, witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.

demand_outlook.claim: Fertilizer demand is expected to remain stable due to normal monsoon forecasts and sufficient water reservoir levels.
demand_outlook.quote: Therefore, we do not expect any stress on the agriculture sector, and consequently, fertilizer demand is expected to remain stable.

demand_outlook.claim: A constructive demand outlook is supported by a stable agricultural environment and favorable monsoon outlook.
demand_outlook.quote: On one hand, a stable agricultural environment supported by a favorable monsoon outlook provides a constructive demand outlook.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its NPK-DAP capacity by 165,000 MT, increasing total capacity to 495,000 MT.
capex_expansion.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is evaluating additional capacity expansion proposals which are pending board approval and statutory disclosures.
capex_expansion.quote: We are currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities. Since these have not yet been approved or disclosed through the statutory channels, we are not in a position to share details at this stage.

capex_expansion.claim: Expanded capacities for NPK/DAP and Sulphuric Acid at Meghnagar are contributing to operational performance.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: The company completed capacity expansion raising total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: NPK/DAP capacity enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Sulphuric acid capacity was strengthened to 99,000 MTPA for backward integration.
capex_expansion.quote: Backward integration strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: The company signed a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement for 70,000 MTPA under the National Green Hydrogen Mission.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of our long-term sustainability strategy, Krishana Phoschem has entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement (GASA) under India’s National Green Hydrogen Mission for 70,000 MTPA.

capex_expansion.claim: The company currently has no additional capital expenditure or expansion plans planned.
capex_expansion.quote: No, so far, we have not planned anything. Whatever we have, it has been implemented.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieves an EBITDA margin of approximately 7%–8% on trading operations and around 16% on manufacturing operations.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: The company passed on approximately 25%–30% of raw material cost increases through subsidy support and MRP adjustments.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs. This has been achieved through a combination of higher subsidy support and revisions in MRPs.

margins_costs.claim: Sulphur prices increased from ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to nearly ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.
margins_costs.quote: Sulphur prices have risen from around ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore due to improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.
margins_costs.quote: Quaterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA per ton on the manufacturing side was in the range of Rs. 5,500 per ton in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: It was in the range of Rs.5,500 per ton.

margins_costs.claim: Global input costs increased in late Q4 FY26 due to supply constraints, freight costs, and gas tightness.
margins_costs.quote: However, from mid-February onwards, global market witnessed firming trends driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, higher logistic and freight costs.

margins_costs.claim: Profitability is expected to decrease slightly in FY27 as the company absorbs part of the increased input costs.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, of course, we will absorb to some extent and as a result, our profitability is expected to come down slightly during the current year FY27.

margins_costs.claim: Trading operations carry an EBITDA margin of around 6%.
margins_costs.quote: Apologies for the interruption, but as mentioned earlier, trading carries an EBITDA margin of around 6%.

orders_capacity.claim: In Q1 FY27, the company achieved a 43% capacity utilization rate for its NPK-DAP unit and 121% for its SSP unit.
orders_capacity.quote: 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: Total fertilizer production reached 89,747 metric tonnes during Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes, showcasing our consistent operational efficiency.

orders_capacity.claim: Q1 sales volume stood at 53,500 MT for NPK-DAP, 36,300 MT for SSP, and 21,000 MT for trading.
orders_capacity.quote: For NPK-DAP, it was 53,500 MT, for SSP 36,300 MT

orders_capacity.claim: The company has an installed manufacturing capacity of 6.15 Lakh MTPA.
Total fertilizer production achieved for FY26 stood at 397,263 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved total production of 397,263 MT, supported by High demand across markets

orders_capacity.claim: Fertilizer production achieved for Q4 FY26 was 94,103 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 94,103 MT, driven by peak Rabi season demand and improved operational throughput

orders_capacity.claim: The rock phosphate beneficiation capacity is around 200,000 tons, with current utilization ranging between 50% and 75%.
orders_capacity.quote: The beneficiation capacity is around 200,000 tons, and current utilization is in the range of 50% to 75%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company executed a 5-for-1 stock split to reduce share face value from ₹10 to ₹2.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of our equity shares from ₹ 10 per share to ₹ 2 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: Finance costs rose to ₹20 crore and depreciation increased to ₹13 crore due to newly commissioned capacities.
capital_allocation.quote: Depreciation increased from around ₹8.7 crore to ₹13 crore, while finance costs increased from around ₹13 crore to ₹20 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: Disciplined capital allocation is one of the five core pillars of the company's strategic blueprint.
capital_allocation.quote: Our strategic blueprint rests on five core pillars: backward integration, capacity expansion, product diversification, disciplined capital allocation and deep farmer connect.

capital_allocation.claim: The company funded its capacity expansion using internal accruals and term loans.
capital_allocation.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

capital_allocation.claim: Excluding subsidies, normal receivable levels range between 50 and 55 days.
capital_allocation.quote: But for subsidy, our receivable levels are normally in the range of 50-55 days.

risks_headwinds.claim: Shipping route disruptions around the Strait of Hormuz led to increased freight costs, procurement costs, and vessel delays.
risks_headwinds.quote: The uncertainty surrounding shipping routes resulted in higher freight costs, delay in vessel movement, and increased procurement costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Cumulative rainfall was 40% below normal by late June, causing national Kharif sowing to drop by 22.7% year-on-year.
risks_headwinds.quote: By the end of June, cumulative rainfall was nearly 40% below normal, resulting in national Kharif sowing declining by 22.7% year-on-year to 182.7 lakh hectares, compared to 236.5 lakh hectares during the corresponding period last year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain primary monitorable risks for the industry.
risks_headwinds.quote: On the other hand, input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorable.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to generate a quarterly revenue of over ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

management_commitments.claim: The green ammonia supply arrangement with SECI is expected to start in FY29.
management_commitments.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current fiscal year.
management_commitments.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects benefits from operational enhanced capacities to meaningfully reflect from FY27 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: With enhanced capacities now operational, we expect the benefits of this expansion to meaningfully reflect in our performance from FY27 onwards, supported by improved scale, operating leverage, and better efficiency levels.
